title: Repeated migration failures
snippet: Press.org Get WordPress WordPress.org Forums Welcome to Support Guidelines Get involved Log in Welcome to Support Guidelines Get involved Log in Skip to content Forums / Plugin:  UpdraftPlus: WP Backup & Migration Plugin / Repeated migration failures Search for: Search forums Repeated migration failures wmconlon (@wmconlon) 1 week, 1 day ago This is a continuation of https://teamupdraft.com/forums/ticket/repeated-migration-failures/#post-7545677 which was closed out prematurely. Essentially, I was using the SendTo feature to migrate sites. The backup to the new sites reported success. Repeatedly, the restoration on the new site failed due to a defective archive. Updraft support says: Just to clarify, the backup archive is checked for completeness/integrity when the restoration process attempts to unpack and restore it.
